column4: STOP: STOP: a controller shutdown or protective alarm is active. Treat it as real until a qualified technician has verified it, even if a gauge reads normal; do not reset and restart to test it.
STOP: STOP THE SET: knocking or bearing noise. Do not restart or crank; use the "Knocking, bearing noise or seizure" checks.
STOP: STOP: metal in the oil or the filter points to bearing damage. Do not run until the bearings have been inspected.
STOP: STOP: milky oil means coolant in the oil. Do not run until the source is found (head gasket, oil cooler, liners).
STOP: STOP: coolant may be entering the cylinders (head gasket, cracked head or liner). Do not run or crank: a hydraulic lock can bend a connecting rod.
STOP: STOP: an overspeed shutdown or runaway has occurred. Do not reset and restart; use the "Overspeed shutdown or runaway" checks.
STOP: STOP: the engine is seized or tight when barred by hand. Do not try to free it with the starter.
STOP: STOP: a hot, swollen or strongly gassing battery. Stop the engine, switch off and isolate the battery charger, ventilate; no sparks or flames; do not move the battery until it has cooled.
STOP: STOP and isolate: burning smell, smoke or arcing from the alternator, panel or wiring. Stop the set, isolate and lock off the electrical supplies; do not re-energise until inspected.
STOP: STOP: leaking or spraying fuel is a fire risk. Stop the engine; do not restart until the leak is repaired.

STOP: STOP THE SET: high crankcase pressure — crankcase explosion risk. Do not restart; do not open the crankcase or remove inspection covers while the engine is hot; let it cool before any inspection.
STOP: STOP: a reverse-power trip. Do not reclose the generator breaker until the cause has been found by a qualified technician.

STOP: STOP and isolate: an earth fault is indicated. Treat the frame and all exposed metalwork as live until tested; do not touch them; isolate, lock off and prove dead with an approved tester before any work.
CAUTION: Safety screen not completed: one or more safety items are marked "Not checked", so safety is NOT confirmed. Check them with the set stopped and isolated before relying on this diagnosis.
